inventory.visualPurpose: The Likelihood ratio block (book 259 mid): the two stacked-fraction equation rows — LR+ (probability of positive result in patient with disorder ÷ probability of positive result in patient without disorder = sensitivity/(1 – specificity) = TP rate/FP rate) and LR– (probability of negative result in patient with disorder ÷ probability of negative result in patient without disorder = (1 – sensitivity)/specificity = FN rate/TN rate) — plus the two rule sentences (the LR+ > 10 / LR– < 0.1 thresholds and the pretest-odds × LR = posttest-odds chain): the diagnostic-testing hinge that turns test characteristics into probability updates
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: PURE TEXT WITH VECTOR FRACTION BARS, no raster (pdfimages: zero raster images; VLM-read at 120dpi, staging-pubh6/vlm-census.txt — VLM available this session): the bold navy row-label heading 'Likelihood ratio' (#004b6c MyriadPro-Bold, PyMuPDF-pinned — the same convention as 'Demographic transition' above and 'Kaplan-Meier curve' below), the equations indented right of the label, then TWO equation rows each printing THREE equal stacked fractions (numerator above a thin horizontal rule, denominator below) joined by two '=' signs vertically centered between numerator and denominator: LR+ = [probability of positive result in patient with disorder / probability of positive result in patient without disorder] = [sensitivity / 1 – specificity] = [TP rate / FP rate]; LR– = [probability of negative result in patient with disorder / probability of negative result in patient without disorder] = [1 – sensitivity / specificity] = [FN rate / TN rate]; the LR labels print with SUPERSCRIPT +/– (6.5pt spans vs the 10pt body); the minus prints as a spaced en-dash (U+2013). Beneath the LR– row, TWO rule sentences in BLACK body text (#231f20 — not red; PyMuPDF-corroborated), printing between the equations and the 'Kaplan-Meier curve' heading (bbox y ≈ 537/550 vs KM title ≈ 589) but EXTRACTING in the raw text layer after the Kaplan-Meier body and figure text (reading-order jumble, documented): 'LR+ > 10 indicates a highly specific test, while LR– < 0.1 indicates a highly sensitive test.' and 'Pretest odds × LR = posttest odds. Posttest probability = posttest odds / (posttest odds + 1).' (× = U+00D7). Raw-layer stacked-fraction interleave: LR+ merges its 2nd+3rd DENOMINATORS onto one line ('1 – specificity FP rate'); LR– mirrors with its 2nd+3rd NUMERATORS merged ('1 – sensitivity FN rate'). No margin notes, mnemonics, red text, asterisk footnotes, or raster images anywhere in the block (VLM-confirmed).
